Hexes SAMPLED from her own concept sheet, not guessed. The physical concept she described for later: light wood tiles, slightly varnished, imperfect hand-painted hues (blue-tape edges, tiny imperfections but a mostly clean line), wood outline ~1/3 cm, tiles approx 2-2.5 inch.
